input.command: for f in README.md app.py config.py stats.py .gitignore; do echo "=== $f (HEAD)"; git show HEAD:$f; done; for f in formatting.py tests/test_report.py; do echo "=== $f (index)"; git show :$f; done; echo; git diff --quiet -- formatting.py tests/test_report.py && echo "worktree==index for changed files"
